In message <qrhklukn9q23mfuqm...@4ax.com>, Chris. QJ
<ro...@gmx.at> writes:
>>Sorry? What time?
>
>that would be 9:00 pm (21:00) GMT (Western Europe), or 10 pm (22:00)
>MET (Middle Europe)

Having had this problem a couple of times recently with people using US
based times citing them in GMT and people in the UK not realising that
GMT doesn't vary with our day-light savings, we're currently on GMT+0100
in the UK, so it'll be five hours ahead.

That would, therefore, be 10:00 pm (22:00) in the UK.
